section.heading: Power features to supercharge your defense
section.subheading: Smart, scalable protection that works while you sleep.

cards.title: Built for massive scale
cards.text: Deploy effortlessly from single clusters to multi-region cloud meshes without latency.

cards.title: Visual policy builder
cards.text: Create, test, and enforce security policies without writing custom code.

cards.title: Automated threat mitigation
cards.text: Neutralize zero-day exploits and abnormal traffic patterns in real time.

cards.title: Native ecosystem integrations
cards.text: Connects directly into your existing CI/CD pipelines, SIEM, and monitoring tools.

pillars.title: Ring-0 Kernel eBPF Telemetry
pillars.description: Nexus injects sandboxed eBPF bytecode directly into Linux kernel space. Analyze syscalls, socket buffers, and process namespaces with under 0.2% CPU overhead and zero sidecar baggage.

pillars.title: Cognitive Neural Swarms
pillars.tagline: Autonomous defense that predicts novel zero-days
pillars.description: Our decentralized AI agents simulate attack graphs in real-time. Polymorphic malware, memory exploits, and credential dumps are isolated and neutralized before processes commit to disk.

pillars.title: 68 Tbps Anycast Scrubbing
pillars.tagline: Global edge scrubbing across 48 Anycast points
pillars.description: Absorb multi-terabit volumetric assaults and complex layer-7 application floods before packets touch your ingress gateways. Built-in BGP route-leak prevention and automated failover.

pillars.title: Immutable Forensic Vault
pillars.description: Every anomalous kernel event is recorded into a tamper-evident cryptographic chain. Replay incident execution step-by-step for compliance attestation with post-quantum lattice signatures.

capabilities.title: Zero Sidecar Footprint
capabilities.description: Native Linux eBPF eliminates the memory and network drag of traditional Kubernetes daemonsets and proxy sidecars.

capabilities.title: Air-Gapped Sovereign Ready
capabilities.description: Deploy on premise with offline model inference, confidential computing enclaves, and zero external egress dependencies.

capabilities.title: Continuous Mesh Attestation
capabilities.description: Hardware-rooted cryptographic verification guarantees that every node running in your cluster is running authentic kernel code.

capabilities.title: Instant Multi-Cloud Peering
capabilities.description: Connect AWS EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, and bare-metal nodes into a single unified self-healing security fabric.
